title: Canonical projective, affine and vector scalar comparison maps
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B, N>0 a common annihilator, and S a scheme on which N is invertible; assume S Noetherian where compact supports or traces require it. With base, line and unit of [def-pur-vector-trace-scalar-coefficient-data], define pullBase(f,d) by inverse scalar/pullback followed by pullback of base(d). Define projective as the actual proper scalar mate on the shifted Tate line followed by pushforward of line, and sum as the biproduct lift of Q(fst)≫line and Q(snd)≫unit. Define affineCoefficient by the two specified affine coefficient-descent identifications and pullBase on the coordinate projection; affineTrace as the inverse affine compact comparison followed by the actual coordinate-tower counit; affine as the chosen compact-support scalar map followed by lower-shriek of affineCoefficient. For a locally free rank-d module sheaf F, define vector by the chosen compact-support scalar map for its bundle projection followed by lower-shriek of pullBase. These are exactly the seven existing canonical composites, moved without changing their terms or signatures; no scalar-compatibility equation is asserted.
